name: vLLM issue #49546: VLLM_MARLIN_INPUT_DTYPE=fp8 (Marlin W4A8-FP8) silently corrupts output on GB10/sm_121a
notes: Root cause not confirmed by a maintainer; reporter gives a code-reading analysis of the arch guard (is_device_capability_family(120) admits sm_121a), the unguarded e4m3 mma.sync, and an fp8-vs-int8 global-scale fold asymmetry. Reproduced by the reporter on GB10 / DGX Spark with Qwen3.5-122B-A10B WNA16 INT4 (AutoRound, group_size 128) MoE.
